author: jracer15
body:
Map Name: Tropical Falls
Gamemode: Walls
Creators: jracer15
Teams: Cyan, Lime, Orange, Yellow

I've been trying to think of this idea for a new map I wanted to make. One idea passed, another idea wouldn't please me. Until I had this dream being stranded on an island had me create this, Tropical Falls! Its a beach/tropical paradise type map with its own stylized feeling. Hope you enjoy!

Map Download: https://www.dropbox.com/s/9pginx9nz4dkaby/TropicalFalls.zip?dl=0
YML Pastebin: http://pastebin.com/b6GqRuba

Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/NYaXz 

*Theres a surprise for my favorite cat! 

*Added another surprise for xAntonia and xCoco!


1.1 Update Includes

  • Added Lilypads around in the middle as well as the quads
  • There is a lot less potions and golden apples in the map(as well as cookies for the cookie monsters)
  • Updated the middles look
  • Added xAntoniaII's _xCoco Beans
  • Updated the cave's look

1.2 Update Includes

  • Change the team colors from brown to yellow
  • Changed the yml wall regions since the sand in the alleyways disappeared
  • Nerfed the Tropical Armor
1.3 Update Includes
  • Decreased the amount of iron in the chests
  • I made Murph_the_cat tamed so hopefully they will spawn in game this time. (For some reason they disappeared in game but when I upload it on single player they were there.)
  • Whenever the walls drop they made gaping holes which looked ugly and unrealistic so I edited that too
  • Add a map.png

* Please leave feedback!

Good work!

replies.author: ClubberNugget
replies.body:
Nice map Jr!! I downloaded the map and here are a couple of things:
==================================================================================
>I like the ground cover, its very nice, not too plain, but not too busy, good job!                                       
==================================================================================
>The Cave looks a little cluttered with ores in my opinion, a little too busy
==================================================================================
>I really like the item spread of your chests, very well balanced! There may be too many potions though.
==================================================================================
>I think the Tropical Armor may be a little overboard, i suggest nerfing them a little bit.
==================================================================================
>Overall i think the gameplay will be nice and I wish the best of luck to this map!
==================================================================================

Btw, i was bored, that's why i laid out my comment like this XD  I should do it like this more often ha
